{
  "name": "complying/compliance",
  "description": "Smart Responsor compliance policy, evidence, retention, and case workflow component.",
  "type": "symfony-bundle",
  "license": "proprietary",
  "minimum-stability": "dev",
  "prefer-stable": true,
  "require": {
    "php": "^8.4",
    "ext-json": "*",
    "aws/aws-sdk-php": "^3.394",
    "cruding/crud": "*@dev",
    "doctrine/doctrine-bundle": "^3.2",
    "doctrine/doctrine-migrations-bundle": "^4.0",
    "doctrine/orm": "^3.5",
    "easycorp/easyadmin-bundle": "^5.0",
    "interfacing/interface": "*@dev",
    "objecting/object": "*@dev",
    "open-telemetry/api": "^1.10",
    "psr/log": "^3.0",
    "symfony/console": "^8.1",
    "symfony/dependency-injection": "^8.1",
    "symfony/dotenv": "^8.1",
    "symfony/expression-language": "^8.1",
    "symfony/framework-bundle": "^8.1",
    "symfony/http-client": "^8.1",
    "symfony/messenger": "^8.1",
    "monolog/monolog": "^3.12",
    "symfony/runtime": "^8.1",
    "symfony/security-bundle": "^8.1",
    "symfony/security-csrf": "^8.1",
    "symfony/serializer": "^8.1",
    "symfony/twig-bundle": "^8.1",
    "symfony/uid": "^8.1",
    "symfony/validator": "^8.1",
    "symfony/yaml": "^8.1",
    "viewing/view": "*@dev"
  },
  "require-dev": {
    "friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer": "^3.95",
    "gating/gate": "*@dev",
    "phpstan/phpstan": "^2.2",
    "phpstan/phpstan-doctrine": "^2.0",
    "phpstan/phpstan-symfony": "^2.0",
    "phpunit/phpunit": "^12.0",
    "symfony/browser-kit": "^8.1",
    "symfony/css-selector": "^8.1"
  },
  "autoload": {"psr-4": {"App\\Complying\\": "src/"}},
  "autoload-dev": {"psr-4": {"App\\Complying\\Tests\\": "tests/"}},
  "repositories": [
    {"type": "path", "url": "../Cruding", "options": {"symlink": true}},
    {"type": "path", "url": "../Viewing", "options": {"symlink": true}},
    {"type": "path", "url": "../Interfacing", "options": {"symlink": true}},
    {"type": "path", "url": "../Objecting", "options": {"symlink": true}},
    {"type": "path", "url": "../Gating", "options": {"symlink": true}}
  ],
  "config": {
    "allow-plugins": {
      "phpstan/extension-installer": true,
      "symfony/flex": true,
      "symfony/runtime": true
    },
    "sort-packages": true
  },
  "extra": {
    "symfony": {"allow-contrib": false, "require": "8.1.*"},
    "symfony-bundle": {"class": "App\\Complying\\ComplyingBundle"}
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test": "phpunit",
    "test:coverage": [
      "@putenv XDEBUG_MODE=coverage",
      "phpunit --path-coverage --coverage-text=var/coverage-summary.txt"
    ],
    "phpstan": "phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G",
    "php-cs-fixer": "php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --verbose",
    "php-cs-fixer:write": "php-cs-fixer fix --verbose",
    "lint:yaml": "php bin/console lint:yaml config --parse-tags",
    "lint:container": "php bin/console lint:container",
    "doctrine:schema:parity": [
      "php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --env=test --no-interaction",
      "php bin/console doctrine:schema:validate --env=test",
      "php bin/console doctrine:migrations:up-to-date --env=test"
    ],
    "doctrine:schema:render-platforms": "php tools/doctrine/render_schema_platforms.php",
    "canon:finalize-layout": "@php tools/canon/compliance_layout_finalize.php",
    "canon:inventory": "@php tools/canon/compliance_inventory.php",
    "canon:phpdoc": "@php tools/canon/compliance_phpdoc_complete.php",
    "canon:rename-types": "@php tools/canon/compliance_type_canonicalize.php",
    "canon:rename-yaml": "@php tools/canon/compliance_yaml_rename.php",
    "gating": "@php ../Gating/bin/gating check --target=. --profile=.gating/compliance_profile.yaml --severity-config=../Gating/.gating/config/severity.yaml",
    "quality": ["@lint:yaml", "@lint:container", "@php-cs-fixer", "@phpstan", "@test", "@gating"]
  }
}

verdict.summary: Complying remains on a seeded snapshot because the assessment runner is in dry-run mode.
strengths: This component is wired into the atlas assessment registry.
risks: Dry-run mode does not perform a live AI verdict.
Repository scan depth is limited to deterministic probes until OPENAI_API_KEY is provided.
Deterministic probes currently report fail status.
next_actions: Enable responses mode with OPENAI_API_KEY for live verdict generation.
Expand repository registry coverage and local_path mappings for additional components.
